info.title: API.SH: Rotten Tomatoes
info.description: The Rotten Tomatoes API from API.SH: public Rotten Tomatoes data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Rotten Tomatoes' browse lists (in theaters, at home, coming soon, TV) with the site's filters and sort: title, type, link, Tomatometer and Popcornmeter with certified flags and sentiment, release text, poster. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rottentomatoes-browse

parameters.name: critics
parameters.description: Comma-separated Tomatometer status: certified_fresh, fresh, rotten.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Best Movies to Stream at Home (2026)

get.description:
The full cast and crew of a movie or show: name, characters, credits, cast or crew, profile link and photo.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rottentomatoes-cast

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A rottentomatoes.com /m/<slug> or /tv/<slug> link or path.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only cast or only crew (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An actor's or director's page on Rotten Tomatoes: name, birthday, birthplace, biography, highest and lowest rated titles, photo, and the filmography (movies or TV) with title, years, credit, characters, Tomatometer and Popcornmeter (score, certified, sentiment), poster and link, in the site's sort orders, 25 a page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rottentomatoes-person

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The person's slug, e.g. `tom_hanks` (people links from `/rottentomatoes/v1/search` with `type=person`).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filmography to list: movies or TV.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Rotten Tomatoes for films, series and people. Films and series: title, link, year (start and end years for series), Tomatometer, certified-fresh flag, sentiment, cast and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rottentomatoes-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only one kind of result (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A TV season on Rotten Tomatoes: Tomatometer and Popcornmeter, synopsis, cast and crew, where to watch, and every episode (number, title, air date, synopsis, link, still).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rottentomatoes-season

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A rottentomatoes.com/tv/<slug>/sNN link or path (or a tv/<slug> link with `season`).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season number when url is the show.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Rotten Tomatoes movie or TV scores
get.description:
A film or series on Rotten Tomatoes: title, year, synopsis, critics consensus, Tomatometer (all and top critics: score, average rating, certified, liked/not liked, review count), Popcornmeter (verified and all audiences), content rating, genres, directors, producers, writers, distributor, production companies, network, original language, release dates, box office, runtime, sound mix, aspect ratio, seasons (series), cast and crew, where to watch, poster.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rottentomatoes-title

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Or the path alone, e.g. `m/parasite_2019` or `tv/the_bear`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Parasite
example.synopsis: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.
example.critics_consensus: An urgent, brilliantly layered look at timely social themes, Parasite finds writer-director Bong Joon Ho in near-total command of his craft.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
